title: Saudi point-of-sale spending, Q3 2023 vs Q3 2022

attempts.text: Saudi Arabia's point-of-sale card spending (SAMA) experienced a significant increase in the first quarter of 2023 compared to the same quarter of the previous year. The average weekly POS value for the quarter increased by 8.5% to SAR 11.77 bn, compared to SAR 10.85 bn in the same quarter of the previous year. This increase is attributed to a rise in the average weekly transactions, which increased by 22.3% to 176.5 million, while the average ticket remained unchanged at SAR 66.7. The other figures show a decrease in the average weekly value, with the other figures showing a decrease in the average weekly value as well. The largest movers (by size of change) are Other (up), Beverage and Food (up), Restaurants & Café (up), Clothing and Footwear (down), and Jewelry (down).

final_text: Average weekly point-of-sale spending in Saudi Arabia was SAR 11.77 bn in Q3 2023, up 8.5% from SAR 10.85 bn in Q3 2022. Average weekly transactions were 176.5 million (up 22.3%), and the average ticket was SAR 66.7 (down 11.3%). The largest movements were: Other increased by SAR 290 mn; Beverage and Food increased by SAR 205 mn; Restaurants & Café increased by SAR 167 mn.
